```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(scales)
library(clusterProfiler)
```

#Read expression counts for 4 tissues 
```{r}
expression_4_tissues <- read.table("/groups/nordborg/projects/genome_organization/manuscript/01_data/expression_thaliana/GSE226691_TPMs.4_tissues.Araport11_annotation.bed", header = T)
```
Clean up dataset
```{r}
#Exclude pollen samples
#expression_3_tissues <- dplyr::select(expression_4_tissues, -starts_with("P."))
#Exclude MT genes
expression_3_tissues <- expression_4_tissues[!grepl("^ATM", expression_4_tissues$gene), ]
#Exclude CP genes
expression_3_tissues <- expression_3_tissues[!grepl("^ATC", expression_3_tissues$gene), ]
```

```{r}
#Log2 dataset
expression_3_tissues_log2 <- expression_3_tissues  # First, create a copy of the original dataframe.
# Apply log2 transformation to all columns except the first one
#Add pseudocount
pseudocount <- 1
expression_3_tissues_log2 <- expression_3_tissues  # Create a copy of the dataframe
expression_3_tissues_log2$gene_freq <- NULL
# Apply log2 transformation to all columns except the first one, adding a pseudocount to avoid -Inf
expression_3_tissues_log2[-1] <- lapply(expression_3_tissues_log2[-1], function(x) log2(x + 1))
```

Intersect with pericentromeric and arm gene defenition 
```{r}
#Read genes with location 
genes_athaliana <- fread("/groups/nordborg/projects/genome_organization/manuscript/01_data/tair10/TAIR10_GFF3_genes_transposons.gff") %>% filter(V3=="gene")
genes_athaliana$gene_id <- sub(".*ID=([^;]+);.*", "\\1", genes_athaliana$V9)
genes_athaliana[, gene_id_clean := sub("Parent=([^.]+)\\..*", "\\1", gene_id)]
genes_athaliana <- genes_athaliana %>% dplyr::select(V1,V4,V5,gene_id_clean)
colnames(genes_athaliana) <- c("chr_thal", "star_thal", "end_thal", "gene_id_thal")


genes_athaliana <- na.omit(genes_athaliana)
# Get only peri-centromeric genes 
peri_centromeres <- data.frame(
  chromosome   = c("Chr1", "Chr2", "Chr3", "Chr4", "Chr5"),
  start = c(8500000, 0, 9250000, 1000000, 8500000),
  end   = c(24500000, 10500000, 17250000, 11000000, 18000000)
)

# Merge genes with pericentromere boundaries by chromosome
genes_merged <- merge(genes_athaliana, peri_centromeres, by.x = "chr_thal", by.y = "chromosome", all = TRUE)
genes_merged <- na.omit(genes_merged)
# Label using ifelse
genes_merged$region <- ifelse(
  genes_merged$star_thal <= genes_merged$end & genes_merged$end_thal >= genes_merged$start,
  "peri-centromere",
  "arm"
)
```
Map  genes expression to have a location
```{r}
expression_3_tissues_log2_with_location <- dplyr::left_join(expression_4_tissues, genes_merged,by = c("gene"="gene_id_thal"))
expression_3_tissues_log2_with_location_filtered <- expression_3_tissues_log2_with_location %>%
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(gene))

#Filter unnecessary columns
expression_3_tissues_log2_with_location <- na.omit(expression_3_tissues_log2_with_location)
```
## Visualize expression patterns
```{r}
# Example to reshape the data to long format
df_long <- pivot_longer(expression_3_tissues_log2_with_location, cols = -c(chr_thal,star_thal,end_thal,start,end,region,gene), 
                        names_to = "sample", values_to = "expression")

# Extract tissue type from sample names
df_long <- df_long %>%
  mutate(tissue = case_when(
    grepl("^F\\.", sample) ~ "F",
    grepl("^P\\.", sample) ~ "P",
    grepl("^R\\.", sample) ~ "R",
    grepl("^S\\.", sample) ~ "S",
    TRUE ~ "Unknown"  # Just in case there are unexpected prefixes
  ))

# Optional: Clean up sample names if necessary (e.g., removing batch info)
df_long <- df_long %>%
  mutate(sample = gsub("([^.]+)\\..*", "\\1", sample))

```

```{r}
library(dplyr)
# Select only 1-1 genes
pannagram_1_1_genes <- read.table("/groups/nordborg/projects/genome_organization/manuscript/04_output/orthologous_genes/pannagram_simsearch/lyata_mn47_v2_thaliana_tair10_only_unique_thal_lyr.csv", header=T)
## Attach thaliana start and end
genes_athaliana <- fread("/groups/nordborg/projects/ddm1_resilencing/11_resources/ref_genome/TAIR10_GFF3_genes_transposons.gff")  %>% filter(V3=="gene")
genes_athaliana$gene_id <- sub(".*ID=([^;]+);.*", "\\1", genes_athaliana$V9)
genes_athaliana[, gene_id_clean := sub("Parent=([^.]+)\\..*", "\\1", gene_id)]
genes_athaliana <- genes_athaliana %>% dplyr::select(V1,V4,V5,gene_id_clean)
colnames(genes_athaliana) <- c("chr_thal", "star_thal", "end_thal", "gene_id_thal")
## Connect coordinates to genes 
pannagram_1_1_genes <- inner_join(pannagram_1_1_genes,genes_athaliana, by=c("thaliana_id"="gene_id_thal"))

#df_long_orth_genes <- df_long$gene %in% pannagram_1_1_genes$thaliana_id
#df_long <- df_long[df_long_orth_genes,]
# Assign each gene to a 300kb window
df_long <- df_long %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    window_start = floor(star_thal / 500000) * 500000 + 1,
    window_end   = window_start + 499999,
  )

# Average expression per window, tissue, region
df_windows <- df_long %>%
  group_by(chr_thal, window_start, region, tissue) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(expression = mean(expression, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")

write.csv2(df_windows, "/groups/nordborg/projects/genome_organization/manuscript/04_output/expression_3_tissues/expression_3_tissues_orth_genes_500kb_not_sliding.csv", quote = F, row.names = F)

```

```{r}
df_windows <- read.table("/groups/nordborg/projects/genome_organization/manuscript/04_output/expression_3_tissues/expression_3_tissues_orth_genes_500kb_not_sliding.csv", sep=";", header=T)

df_windows$expression <- as.numeric(
  sub(",", ".", as.character(df_windows$expression), fixed = TRUE))
#Wilcoxon test per tissue
# Rename regions first
df_windows <- df_windows %>%
  mutate(region = recode(region, "peri-centromere" = "Pericentromere", "arm" = "Arm"))

# Recompute wilcox with new names

wilcox_results <- df_windows %>%
  group_by(tissue) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    p = wilcox.test(expression[region == "Pericentromere"],
                    expression[region == "Arm"])$p.value,
    y_pos = max(expression, na.rm = TRUE) * 1.05,
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(label = case_when(
    p < 0.001 ~ "***",
    p < 0.01  ~ "**",
    p < 0.05  ~ "*",
    TRUE      ~ "ns"
  ))


p <- ggplot(df_windows %>% mutate(region = factor(region, levels = c("Pericentromere", "Arm"))),
       aes(x = region, y = expression, fill = region)) +
  geom_violin(width = 0.7, alpha = 0.4, trim = TRUE, na.rm = TRUE) +
  geom_boxplot(width = 0.2, alpha = 0.8, outlier.shape = NA, na.rm = TRUE) +
  #geom_text(data = wilcox_results, aes(x = 1.5, y = y_pos * 1.02, label = label),
  #          inherit.aes = FALSE, size = 10) +
  #geom_segment(data = wilcox_results, aes(x = 1, xend = 2, y = y_pos * 0.99, yend = y_pos * 0.99),
  #             inherit.aes = FALSE) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("Arm" = "#e08214", "Pericentromere" = "#8073ac")) +
  facet_wrap(~ tissue, scales = "free_y", ncol = 4) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Mean TPM (300kb windows)") +
  theme_bw(base_size = 20) +
  theme(strip.background = element_blank(), strip.text = element_text(size = 24), legend.position = "none")

ggsave("/groups/nordborg/projects/genome_organization/manuscript/04_output/figures/expression_thaliana.png",
       plot = p,
       width = 300, height = 200, units = "mm", dpi = 600,
       device = png, type = "cairo", bg = "white")
```

## Enrichment analysis
```{r}
library(dplyr)

# Get unique genes per region
genes_per_region <- df_long %>%
  distinct(gene, region,expression)

write.csv(df_long,"/groups/nordborg/projects/genome_organization/manuscript/04_output/expression_3_tissues/genes_with_regions_thaliana.csv", quote = F, row.names = F, sep="\t")
genes_arm <- genes_per_region %>% filter(region == "arm") %>% pull(gene)
genes_peri <- genes_per_region %>% filter(region == "peri-centromere") %>% pull(gene)

# Universe = all genes in your dataset
universe <- genes_per_region %>% pull(gene) %>% unique()

```

```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(clusterProfiler)
library(org.At.tair.db)
library(enrichplot)
library(ggplot2)

out <- "/groups/nordborg/projects/genome_organization/manuscript/04_output/expression_3_tissues/"
clean <- function(x) unique(toupper(sub("\\..*$", "", x)))   # AT1G01010.1 -> AT1G01010

genes_per_region <- df_long %>% distinct(gene, region)
genes_arm  <- clean(genes_per_region$gene[genes_per_region$region == "arm"])
genes_peri <- clean(genes_per_region$gene[genes_per_region$region == "peri-centromere"])
universe   <- clean(genes_per_region$gene)

# GO enrichment for both regions
run_go <- function(genes) {
  enrichGO(gene          = genes,
           universe      = universe,
           OrgDb         = org.At.tair.db,
           keyType       = "TAIR",
           ont           = "ALL",          # BP + MF + CC
           pAdjustMethod = "BH",
           pvalueCutoff  = 0.1,
           qvalueCutoff  = 0.1)
}
```

```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)

## Fold enrichment
ratio <- function(x) sapply(strsplit(x, "/"), \(v) as.numeric(v[1]) / as.numeric(v[2]))

go_df <- bind_rows(
  as.data.frame(go_arm)  %>% mutate(region = "Arm"),
  as.data.frame(go_peri) %>% mutate(region = "Pericentromere")
) %>%
  mutate(fold_enrichment = ratio(GeneRatio) / ratio(BgRatio))

go_df <- go_df[go_df$ONTOLOGY=="MF",]
# top terms per region and ontology
top_terms <- go_df %>%
  group_by(region, ONTOLOGY) %>%
  slice_min(p.adjust, n = 3) %>%
  pull(ID) %>% unique()

# Fix long description
go_df$Description[go_df$Description == "acyltransferase activity, transferring groups other than amino-acyl groups"] <- "acyltransferase activity"
p <- go_df %>%
  filter(ID %in% top_terms) %>%
  ggplot(aes(region, reorder(Description, fold_enrichment),
             size = Count, colour = -log10(p.adjust))) +
  geom_point() +
  scale_size(range = c(4, 12)) +      # min and max point size (default is c(1, 6))
  scale_colour_viridis_c() +
  labs(x = NULL, y = NULL, size = "Genes", colour = "-log10 FDR",
       title = "GO:MF") +
  theme_bw(base_size = 16)

ggsave("/groups/nordborg/projects/genome_organization/manuscript/04_output/figures/go_arm_pericentromere.png",
       plot = p,
       width = 300, height = 200, units = "mm", dpi = 600,
       device = png, type = "cairo", bg = "white")
```


### Analyze lyrata expression
```{r}
expression_lyrata <- read.table("/groups/nordborg/projects/genome_organization/manuscript/01_data/expression_alyrata/Fcounts_old_annot_paired_end.txt", header = T)
# Read centromeric repeat
centromeres <- read.table("/groups/nordborg/projects/genome_organization/manuscript/01_data/expression_alyrata/centromeric_repeats_nt1.txt", header = F)
colnames(centromeres) <- c("chr", "start", "stop")
## Add several Mbp
centromeres$start <- centromeres$start-250000
centromeres$stop <- centromeres$stop+250000
```


```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)

# Calculate mean expression across all sample columns
expression_lyrata_windows <- expression_lyrata %>%
  filter(Chr %in% paste0("scaffold_", 1:3)) %>%
  mutate(mean_expr = rowMeans(dplyr::select(., -c(Geneid, Chr, Start, End, Strand, Length)), na.rm = TRUE),
         mid_pos = (Start + End) / 2,
         window = floor(mid_pos / 300000) * 300000) %>%
  group_by(Chr, window) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(mean_expr_window = mean(mean_expr, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")

ggplot(expression_lyrata_windows, aes(x = window, y = log2(mean_expr_window + 1))) +
  geom_line(alpha = 0.5) +
  geom_smooth(method = "loess", span = 0.1, se = FALSE, color = "darkgreen") +
  facet_wrap(~ Chr, scales = "free") +
  labs(x = "Chromosomal position (bp)", y = "Mean expression (log2 + 1)", title = "Gene expression in 100kb windows") +
  theme_bw(base_size = 14)
```



```{r}

med_per_chr <- expression_lyrata_windows %>%
  group_by(Chr) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(median_expr = median(log2(mean_expr_window + 1), na.rm = TRUE))

# Join centromere info and assign region
expression_lyrata_windows <- expression_lyrata_windows %>%
  left_join(centromeres, by = c("Chr" = "chr")) %>%
  mutate(region = case_when(
    window < start ~ "left",
    window > stop  ~ "right",
    TRUE           ~ "centromere"
  ))

p <- ggplot(expression_lyrata_windows, aes(x = window / 1e6, y = log2(mean_expr_window + 1))) +
  geom_rect(data = centromeres,
            aes(xmin = start / 1e6, xmax = stop / 1e6, ymin = -Inf, ymax = Inf),
            inherit.aes = FALSE, fill = "darkgrey", alpha = 0.4) +
  geom_hline(data = med_per_chr, aes(yintercept = median_expr),
             linetype = "dashed", color = "#111844", linewidth = 0.5) +
  geom_point(data = . %>% filter(region %in% c("left", "right")),
             aes(group = interaction(Chr, region)), size = 0.8, color = "#111844", alpha = 0.5) +
  geom_smooth(data = . %>% filter(region == "left"),
              method = "loess", span = 0.2, se = FALSE, color = "#111844") +
  geom_smooth(data = . %>% filter(region == "right"),
              method = "loess", span = 0.2, se = FALSE, color = "#111844") +
  facet_wrap(~ Chr, scales = "free_x", ncol = 4) +
  labs(x = "Position (Mb)", y = "Mean expression in 300KB windows (log2 + 1)") +
  theme_bw(base_size = 20) +
  theme(
    strip.background = element_blank(),
    strip.text = element_text(),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank())

ggsave("/groups/nordborg/projects/genome_organization/manuscript/04_output/figures/expression_lyrata.png",
       plot = p,
       width = 300, height = 200, units = "mm", dpi = 600,
       device = png, type = "cairo", bg = "white")
```


```{r}
keep_scaffolds <- c("scaffold_1", "scaffold_2")
p <- ggplot(expression_lyrata_windows, aes(x = window / 1e6, y = log2(mean_expr_window + 1))) +
```
